name: WARDEN
description: Masks credentials (and personal data when configured) before the model sees them, restores them only for allowed tools, and runs the WARDEN flow guard on every tool call.

personal.description: Personal-data profile: gdpr, us, ru-152fz, pci, custom, or off (default off).

maskConfig.description: Path of a WARDEN mask config JSON file (overrides the WARDEN_MASK* environment).

flowGuard.description: Run the WARDEN flow guard on every tool call (default true).
